environment.description: Ubuntu 22.04 container running as root. The asset-pipeline.py CLI is invoked by a CI/CD webhook handler that accepts ZIP uploads from external contributors. DEPLOY_DIR=/var/www/static is on the same filesystem as /var/www/html (the main application). The Nginx frontend serves all files from /var/www/ with standard configuration. No filesystem isolation, no read-only mounts, no AppArmor/SELinux confinement. Python 3.10 zipfile module does not prevent path traversal when using manual extraction (os.path.join with relative paths containing '../').

config.sri_enforcement: none - manifest is generated but not consumed by any verification layer
